properties.name: essentials.json.wire-format-check
properties.description: What to do at startup with a JSONSerializer or JSONEventSerializer bean, backed by a Jackson3JSONSerializer, whose mapper does not write and read the JSON format Essentials persists (typically a replacement bean built on a hand-configured JsonMapper). WARN logs one ERROR banner per deviating bean, FAIL stops the application, OFF skips the check. Spring Boot's web JsonMapper is not checked.

properties.name: essentials.durable-queues.transactional-mode
properties.description: Removed in 0.60.0. Selected the durable queues' TransactionalMode (FullyTransactional or SingleOperationTransaction).

deprecation.reason: Removed in 0.60.0 and ignored: every queue operation now runs in its own transaction, as SingleOperationTransaction did. If it was set to fully-transactional, delivery semantics changed - see docs/MIGRATION-0.60.md 'TransactionalMode is retired'.

properties.name: essentials.durable-queues.use-ordered-unordered-query
properties.description: Removed in 0.60.0. Selected between the unified claim query and the ordered/unordered query pair.

deprecation.reason: Removed in 0.60.0 and ignored: the ordered/unordered query pair is the only claim path - see docs/MIGRATION-0.60.md 'useOrderedUnorderedQuery is removed'.

properties.name: essentials.durable-queues.enable-queue-statistics

deprecation.reason: Removed in 0.60.0 and ignored, with the trigger-based queue statistics. Per-instance statistics (QueueStatisticsRegistry) replace them and need no property - see docs/MIGRATION-0.60.md 'The queue statistics feature is removed'.
